guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company has reaffirmed its adjusted diluted earnings per share(2) (EPS) outlook for full-year 2026 of $1.60 to $1.70. This outlook assumes approximately $10 million of interest income during the fourth quarter of 2026 and no significant changes in interest rates or the redeployment of cash proceeds for the remainder of the year. The Company now expects 4% to 6% year-over-year sales growth across its combined Packaging and Specialty Products businesses, a modest increase from its prior outlook of 3% to 6%. The Company also expects approximately 250 basis points of adjusted operating profit margin expansion year-over-year, reflecting the benefits of cost-reduction actions and organizational realignment initiatives, partially offset by the extended throughput challenges within Specialty Products.
